entry.title: LXRXXL ZYNTH 0.2.0
entry.summary: LXRXXL ZYNTH for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC), armv7. Unzip, then follow INSTALL.md (root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod). `LXRXXL-ZYNTH-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` is the plugin; `LXRXXL-ZYNTH-<version>-source.zip` its complete source (required by the LXR02 Open-Source license: non-commercial use only; MACRO, WAVE and PHYS are Mutable Instruments' Braids and Plaits, MIT). Tested on a device when listed in tested.json (a pre-release until then). See CHANGELOG.md for what changed.
